spans.s: व्योमक्˚, i. e. व्योमन्-, m. Śiva.
व्योमगङ्गा, i. e. व्योमन्-, f. the supposed Ganges of [] the sky.
व्योमचर, i. e. व्योमन्-, adj. passing through the air.
व्यो-कार (व्यो is perhaps an imitative sound), m. A blacksmith.

व्योमन्, n.
 1. The sky, atmosphere, heaven, Pañc. ii. d. 21; Vikr. d. 20.
 2. Æther, Bhāṣāp. 2.
 3.
. A temple sacred to the sun.
व्योष, i. e. वि-उष् + अ, n. The aggregate of three spices, black pepper, long pepper, and dry ginger.
